## Goal
- Build and deploy IVX IA as a **fully owner-controlled AI engineering platform** that can operate, code, test, commit, deploy, monitor, and recover WITHOUT Rork — execute end-to-end, not return only a plan; remove all Rork dependencies from the normal development path; verify and sync all credentials live; **rebuild IVX Owner AI as a REAL senior developer that never reports false completion**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries
- **Owner's 17-PHASE ENTERPRISE AUTH RECOVERY MANDATE (2026-07-21)**: critical security incident — owner password exposed in screenshot; full enterprise auth overhaul: freeze, audit Supabase project, audit owner user, reset password, revoke sessions, 12-char password policy, trace IDs, remove auth conflicts, session management, auth vs authorization separation, rate limiting, optional MFA (OFF by default), email delivery, member self-service, DB/RLS QA, 40 automated tests, physical-device QA, structured production proof
- **CRITICAL**: DEPLOYED ≠ VERIFIED; a CODE_FIX/UI_FIX/FEATURE task with no code change is NOT complete
- **CRITICAL SECURITY**: never display/log/store passwords in screenshots, logs, analytics, alerts, proof reports; redact as ********; never hardcode passwords; never bypass Supabase auth
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use Python `gzip.compress()` + `base64.b64encode()`; repo-root relative paths
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Render restart API: `{action: "render_restart_service", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Render env var upsert: `{action: "render_upsert_env_var", input: {key, value}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}`
- Render update source: `{action: "render_update_source", input: {branch: "main", commitSha}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE"}` — forces specific commit
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at.json` (JSON with `accessToken` field); re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` — returns `uploadUrl` (S3 presigned PUT) + `publicUrl`; then `curl -X PUT` the APK to `uploadUrl`
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Health endpoint: `GET https://api.ivxholding.com/health` returns `{commit, status}` — use to verify deploy propagation
- `bun test backend/` = 1709 pass / 0 fail (6230 expects)
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or timeout; Render propagation ~2-4 min; Gradle build takes ~2-3 min (run via nohup background + poll)
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` before tests or tsc
- `watchman` disabled (moved to `/usr/local/bin/watchman.disabled`) to prevent Metro/Gradle build hangs
- MFA must be optional, OFF by default; user enables in Settings → Security → Two-Factor Authentication; never auto-enroll

## Progress
### Done
- **CERTIFICATION FIX — DEFECT 1 & 2 — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Commits: `83cd9efdf9ec` + `ebbdc7c52d42` + `11b323a86aba` + `ada4bddd4846` + `2efbffcc15e3`
  - 11 routing + QA regression tests all passing

- **ENTERPRISE AUTH RECOVERY — PHASES 1-17 — CODE-LEVEL COMPLETE (~70% VERIFIED)**
  - Phase 1-4: Security freeze, Supabase project match, owner audit, password invalidation + session revocation — all executed live
  - Phase 5: Password policy 12-char min — commit `9863d7b01187`
  - Phase 6: Login trace IDs — commit `35c42edc61dd`
  - Phase 7-11: Auth conflicts audit, MFA verified OFF by default
  - Phase 15: 32/32 enterprise auth tests pass (94 expects)
  - Phase 17: Production proof report delivered
  - APK v1.4.27(59) — BUILT, UPLOADED, LIVE-VERIFIED — `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.27.apk`

- **FORGOT PASSWORD REDIRECT URL BUG — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED**
  - `expo/components/IVXAuthCard.tsx` line 537 inline "Forgot Password?" handler used wrong redirect URL; now uses `getPasswordResetRedirectUrl()`
  - Added 429 rate-limit detection + user-friendly error message
  - Commit: `6cda0ad8e410`

- **FORGOT PASSWORD 429 RATE-LIMIT HANDLING — FIXED, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED**
  - `expo/app/forgot-password.tsx` detects 429 `over_email_send_rate_limit` and shows user-friendly wait message
  - Commit: `ecad2525ce39`

- **BACKEND SES PASSWORD RESET FALLBACK — BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Action `send_owner_password_reset_email_via_ses` generates Supabase recovery link via admin REST API and sends via Amazon SES
  - Commits: `49c48d7a` → `d4023019` → `d756a08e` → `a78dbb7c`

- **APK v1.4.28(60) — BUILT, UPLOADED, LIVE-VERIFIED**
  - Fixed missing `splashscreen_logo` by generating assets with ffmpeg from `expo/assets/images/splash-icon.png` and `icon.png`
  - Generated `splashscreen_logo.png` (512×512) in `drawable/`, `ic_launcher.png` / `ic_launcher_round.png` / `ic_launcher_foreground.png` in all mipmap-* dirs
  - Gradle clean + rebuild succeeded: 82,943,307 bytes, md5 `c18bdb14b83b80215889d40284eee276`
  - Uploaded to `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.28.apk` — S3 ETag verified == local md5

- **AWS SES IDENTITY VERIFICATION ACTIONS — BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - Added `verifySesEmailIdentity()` and `listSesIdentities()` to `backend/services/ivx-ses-email.ts`
  - Added `verify_ses_email_identity` and `list_ses_identities` actions to deploy control dispatcher
  - GitHub commits: `f85b4d9f` (SES service) + `954d63c1` (deploy control wiring)
  - Local commit: `032c9909`
  - `list_ses_identities` result: verified identities = `ivxholding.com`, `osconstructors@gmail.com`, `noreply@ivxholding.com`
  - `verify_ses_email_identity` for `iperez4242@gmail.com` returned HTTP 200 — AWS sent verification email
  - After verification call, `list_ses_identities` shows `iperez4242@gmail.com` in list (but SES still rejects sends — identity is pending verification, not confirmed)

- **`generate_owner_password_reset_link` ACTION — BUILT, COMMITTED, DEPLOYED, LIVE**
  - New action returns the Supabase reset link directly in the API response — bypasses email delivery entirely
  - GitHub commit: `75ee54f1`
  - Link generated successfully: `https://kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb.supabase.co/auth/v1/verify?token=...&type=recovery&redirect_to=http://localhost:3000`
  - Manual corrected link provided to owner with `redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fivxholding.com%2Freset-password`

- **SUPABASE AUTH CONFIG DIAGNOSTICS — ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED**
  - Supabase Auth config field for allowed redirect URLs is `uri_allow_list` (space-separated string), NOT `redirect_urls` (array)
  - Backend was patching `redirect_urls` which Supabase API silently accepts (200 OK) but does NOT persist
  - `site_url` is set to `http://localhost:3000` in Supabase config — this is why `redirect_to` falls back to localhost
  - `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN` IS configured on backend runtime (tokenPresent: true, projectRef: `kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb`)
  - `uri_allow_list` is currently empty string `""`
  - PUT method returns 404 (only PATCH is supported for auth config)
  - Diagnostic commits: `40dbdf1e` (snake_case fix) + `35556142` (auto-register attempt) + `3420a934` (diagnostics) + `ed2ca8d0` (verify-after-PATCH + PUT fallback)

### In Progress
- **SUPABASE `uri_allow_list` FIX — LOCAL EDIT DONE, NEEDS COMMIT + DEPLOY**
  - `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` `ensureSupabaseAuthRedirectUrl()` updated to use `uri_allow_list` (space-separated string) instead of `redirect_urls` (array)
  - Also sets `site_url` to `https://ivxholding.com` in the PATCH body
  - Local file edited but NOT yet committed to GitHub or deployed
  - After deploy: regenerate link should have `redirect_to=https://ivxholding.com/reset-password`

- **AWS SES VERIFICATION FOR `iperez4242@gmail.com` — PENDING**
  - AWS sent verification email to `iperez4242@gmail.com` (VerifyEmailIdentity API returned 200)
  - Owner has not confirmed clicking the AWS verification link
  - SES still rejects sends: `"Email address is not verified. The following identities failed the check in region US-EAST-1: iperez4242@gmail.com"`
  - SES account is in sandbox mode — requires both sender AND recipient to be verified

### Blocked
- **OWNER CANNOT SIGN IN** — old password invalidated; reset email not arriving due to:
  1. Supabase 429 rate limit (primary) — every `/recover` call rejected
  2. AWS SES sandbox mode — `iperez4242@gmail.com` identity pending verification (owner must click AWS verification email link)
  3. Supabase `uri_allow_list` empty + `site_url` set to `http://localhost:3000` — auto-generated reset links redirect to localhost
- **Workaround available**: owner can use the manually corrected reset link provided in chat (with `redirect_to=https%3A%2F%2Fivxholding.com%2Freset-password`) to set a new password NOW
- 34 system-managed history files contain exposed password (read-only, outside sandbox write scope)
- Physical-device QA: login,
